text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"uses a full essay structure with introduction, three body paragraphs, and a conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The writing is arranged into clear sections that help guide the reader through the main points."},{"evidence":"includes transitions like 'First,' 'Second,' 'Additionally,' and 'In conclusion'","quality":"cohesive devices","description":"The essay uses linking words and sentence starters to connect ideas and signal progression."},{"evidence":"develops three separate reasons about seeing workers, learning new things, and treating animals","quality":"idea development","description":"The response expands on its points with related explanations rather than repeating the same fragment."},{"evidence":"writes multiple complete sentences that mostly stay on the same topic","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows more control over forming readable sentences and maintaining a sustained response."},{"evidence":"fewer repeated prompt fragments and copied text","quality":"task focus","description":"The writing stays more consistently on the student’s own response instead of being overwhelmed by duplicated prompt material."}]}
